instruction: Run `C:\Users\user\Desktop\opt_target.cir` in native PSpice. Keep the native simulator artifacts as `C:\Users\user\Desktop\tune.out`, `C:\Users\user\Desktop\tune_measure.txt`, and `C:\Users\user\Desktop\tune.dat`. Then inspect the stepped transient results at `5 us` and write `C:\Users\user\Desktop\tune_result.json`. The JSON must contain `best_R_FB`, `best_R_GAIN`, `V_OUT_at_5us`, `abs_error_mV`, `meets_20mV_spec`, and `n_candidates` for the candidate closest to the `3.30 V` target. [Software] Use the native PSpice command-line simulator `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\psp_cmd.exe`.
